packageRules.description: Nothing automerges — every update is reviewed and merged by a human.
Batch ALL non-major updates into a single weekly PR to keep the queue small.
Major updates each get their own PR (potentially breaking), labeled so they stand out and show on the dashboard.
AGP sets a minimum Gradle version, so the plugin and the wrapper always move together in one PR.
pub packages ship inside the app: let a release age 3 days before it is proposed.
JDK 17 is the release JDK verified reproducible against F-Droid. JDK 25 changes classes.dex (#96); raise this pin to try another.
